newsitem.title: USA: New Miami, Fla., city manager takes over today.
newsitem.headline: New Miami, Fla., city manager takes over today.

text.p: An interim Miami city manager is scheduled to step down Friday afternoon, handing over to the new manager the keys to the city along with a report recommending what steps administrators need to take for the city to survive a $68 million budget shortfall.
Ed Marquez will formally take over his new duties at a ceremony scheduled at city hall at 1600 EST.

Merrett Stierheim, the interim city manager, has called for an increase in garbage collection rates and an assessment for fire-rescue service. He took over temporary responsibility for the city budget on Sept. 10 after Miami's city manager resigned due to a criminal investigation.
Stierheim has worked with union leaders and more than 50 executives on loan to the city to craft a new budget and recovery plan.
